decisions.statement: The files a command line names are read by `file-arguing` rather than here.
A refusal the reading answers with is passed back untouched.
A body to write goes in through the change adding a file of any kind.
A path to take away goes through the change removing a file.
Every body a call has is worked out before any of them is run.
No check runs over a body landed here.
The landing a file goes through is handed in.
A call that landed is answered with the paths landed and the commit holding them.
A landing that wrote before it went wrong answers the same beside its refusals.
A call that threw after the landing committed names that commit in its refusal.
A refusal the landing answered exits with the code that landing stated.
No ask here brings a body in off the tree.
Nothing here keeps an edit rather than landing it.
Which callers may land this way is settled elsewhere.

definition: the files a command line names, landed with no gate run over the bodies
